blocks.text: Why technical recruiters need a faster Slack workflow

Technical recruiting requires constant context switching. You move from candidate sourcing in LinkedIn Recruiter to internal discussions in Slack. Then you jump to an ATS like Workable. Slack often becomes the bottleneck for your day. You spend too much time searching for old messages or typing the same updates to hiring managers.

On a Mac, you can reclaim your time by mastering the interface. Stop relying on your mouse for every action. Slack has built-in shortcuts for almost everything. When you add Lazur to your setup, you gain a voice assistant that understands your screen. You can ask it to find a specific candidate thread or clarify a hiring manager requirement without clicking through menus.
Essential Slack keyboard shortcuts for recruiters
Speed is your best friend when managing high volumes of candidates. These shortcuts save seconds every time you use them. Over a week, they save hours.

If you find yourself searching for the same information repeatedly, use search modifiers. Type from:@name to find messages from a specific hiring manager. Use in:#channel to narrow your search to a specific requisition channel. These small adjustments keep your focus on the actual recruiting work.

Recruiters often face interruptions. You might be deep in a resume screen when a ping arrives. Use the profile menu to set your status. This lets your team know you are busy without you having to reply to every message. You can also use /dnd to pause notifications for a set time, like 30 minutes or an hour.

If you miss important updates, check your notification settings. Open preferences with ⌘ + , and go to the Notifications tab. Ensure your keywords are set correctly. This way, you only get alerted for critical updates about high-priority roles.
How to use Lazur for faster communication

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It sees what you see. When you hold ⌥ ⌘, you can ask questions about your current Slack window. If you are lost in a long thread, ask Lazur to summarize the last few points. It listens and answers out loud. It does not click for you, but it guides you to the right place.

You can also use the fn key to dictate your messages. This is useful when you have a lot to say to a candidate or hiring manager. Speak your thoughts clearly, and Lazur types them out. It keeps your hands on the keyboard for other tasks. It is not just dictation; it helps you draft professional responses in seconds.
Common mistakes and how to fix them

Many recruiters let their Slack cache grow too large. This causes the app to lag or crash. If your Slack feels slow, go to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This is a simple fix that solves many performance issues. Another mistake is ignoring threads. Always reply in a thread to keep channels clean. Use ⌘ + Shift + T to jump to your threads view quickly.

Organize your channels by priority. Use the sidebar to group channels by requisition. If you have too many, use the mute function to hide low-priority channels. Right-click a channel and select Mute to keep your sidebar clean. This ensures you only see what matters for your current day.

For documentation, do not rely on Slack alone. Use Slack to discuss, but move final notes to your ATS or Notion. If you need to save a message for later, hover over it and click the bookmark icon. You can access these later in your saved items list. This prevents important candidate details from getting buried in the chat history.

faq.question: How do I jump to a specific conversation in Slack on Mac?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + K to open the quick switcher. Type the name of the channel or person and press Enter.

faq.question: Can Lazur help me navigate Slack?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where a specific setting or channel is. It will draw a circle on your screen to show you the location.

faq.question: What should I do if Slack is running slowly?
faq.answer: Go to the Help menu, select Troubleshooting, and then click Clear Cache and Restart.

faq.question: How can I dictate text into Slack?
faq.answer: Hold the fn key and start speaking. Lazur will transcribe your words directly into the Slack message field at your cursor.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with other apps on my Mac?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur works in any app on your Mac, including your ATS, browser, and document editors.
